# Generate e2e — --quiet suppresses progress not network disclosure.

mkdir $GEN_ROOT/parent-quiet
chmod 0700 $GEN_ROOT/parent-quiet

exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/parent-quiet/minimal-cli --quiet
! stdout 'progress:'
stdout 'network disclosure:'
stdout 'go-mod-tidy'
! stdout 'generate: wrote'
exists $GEN_ROOT/parent-quiet/minimal-cli/go.mod

# Full progress names present without --quiet (sample Section 29.2 ids).
mkdir $GEN_ROOT/parent-prog
chmod 0700 $GEN_ROOT/parent-prog
exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/parent-prog/minimal-cli
stdout 'progress: tool-preflight'
stdout 'progress: report-plan-network'
stdout 'progress: create-stage'
stdout 'progress: commit'
stdout 'generate: wrote'
stdout 'git initialized'
stdout 'no commits'
